Rene Coig renecoig@uw.edu

Load required packages
```{r,load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(growthcurver)
```


Read in data
```{r,read in raw data}
Dev<-read.csv("TDO 072023/TDO2 DevTime2.csv")
```
Compute sums
```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
Dev%>%group_by(Color,Hours,Sex) %>%
  summarise(
    Sex = Sex,
    Treatment = Treatment,
    Color = Color,
    Hours=Hours,
    Totalpupae=Totalpupae,
    NTreat = sum(CumulativeSum, na.rm = TRUE))->Dev_Sum
Dev_Sum<-distinct(Dev_Sum)
Dev_Sum$Color<-as.factor(Dev_Sum$Color)
levels(Dev_Sum$Color)

Dev%>%group_by(Color,Hours,Sex,EggPicker) %>%
  summarise(
    Sex = Sex,
    EggPicker = EggPicker,
    Treatment = Treatment,
    Color = Color,
    Hours=Hours,
    Totalpupae=Totalpupae,
    NTreat = sum(CumulativeSum, na.rm = TRUE))->Dev_Sum2
Dev_Sum2<-distinct(Dev_Sum2)
Dev_Sum2$Color<-as.factor(Dev_Sum2$Color)

Dev%>%group_by(Color,Hours,Sex,Group) %>%
  summarise(
    Sex = Sex,
    Group = Group,
    Treatment = Treatment,
    Color = Color,
    Hours=Hours,
    Totalpupae=Totalpupae,
    NTreat = sum(CumulativeSum, na.rm = TRUE))->Dev_Sum3
Dev_Sum3<-distinct(Dev_Sum3)
Dev_Sum3$Color<-as.factor(Dev_Sum3$Color)

```
Compute sums remaining
```{r}
Dev_Sum$Rem<-Dev_Sum$Totalpupae-Dev_Sum$NTreat
Dev_Sum$Prop<-Dev_Sum$Rem/Dev_Sum$Totalpupae
Dev_Sum2$Rem<-Dev_Sum2$Totalpupae-Dev_Sum2$NTreat
Dev_Sum2$Prop<-Dev_Sum2$Rem/Dev_Sum2$Totalpupae
Dev_Sum3$Rem<-Dev_Sum3$Totalpupae-Dev_Sum3$NTreat
Dev_Sum3$Prop<-Dev_Sum3$Rem/Dev_Sum3$Totalpupae
Dev$Rem<-Dev$Npupae-Dev$CumulativeSum
Dev$Prop<-Dev$Rem/Dev$Npupae
```

```{r}
TDO10<-Dev_Sum2%>%filter(Color=="Blue2"|Color=="Red1")
TDO15<-Dev_Sum2%>%filter(Color=="Blue2"|Color=="Red2")
TDO20<-Dev_Sum2%>%filter(Color=="Blue3"|Color=="Red3")

ggplot(TDO10, aes(x = Hours, y = NTreat, group = interaction(Treatment,Sex)))+
  geom_line(aes(color=Treatment, linetype=Sex),linewidth=1)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("purple", "black"))+
  facet_grid(~EggPicker)+
  xlab("Hours")+
  ylab("Population")+
  ggtitle("TDO Inhibitor, 10mM, w[1118]")

ggplot(TDO15, aes(x = Hours, y = NTreat, group = interaction(Treatment,Sex)))+
  geom_line(aes(color=Treatment, linetype=Sex),linewidth=1)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("purple", "black"))+
  facet_grid(~EggPicker)+
  xlab("Hours")+
  ylab("Population")+
  ggtitle("TDO Inhibitor, 15mM, w[1118]")

ggplot(TDO20, aes(x = Hours, y = NTreat, group = interaction(Treatment,Sex)))+
  geom_line(aes(color=Treatment, linetype=Sex),linewidth=1)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("purple", "black"))+
  facet_grid(~EggPicker)+
  xlab("Hours")+
  ylab("Population")+
  ggtitle("TDO Inhibitor, 20mM, w[1118]")
```
